notes.title: [UPDATE] August 14 - New Auto-Fire Mode & Sound Optimization

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 13 — New Friends Leaderboard, Crosshair Visibility Adjustment
notes.notes: [h3]Friends Ranking Added to Leaderboards, Enhanced & Adjustable Crosshair Visibility[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a [b]Friends Leaderboard[/b] to the rankings system.[/p][/*][*][p]Further reduced [b]memory and VRAM usage[/b] — package size has dropped from the initial 4.4 GB to 3.3 GB.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]initial attack speed[/b] of the [b]Sentinel mech[/b] and improved the [b]drop rate of elemental cards[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual effects of [b]explosive supply drops[/b] to make them easier to distinguish.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]third-person camera position and FOV[/b] to reduce motion sickness.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced [b]crosshair contrast and visibility[/b], and added a [b]color customization option[/b] in settings — supports high-contrast colors (e.g., green).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]upgrade cards[/b] for card towers — significantly increased values for HP boost, attack speed boost, and tower armor boost cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]movement speed of mobile turrets[/b] when following the player.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]language setting was sometimes lost[/b] when entering the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed untranslated text on the [b]results screen[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks to all Survivors for your feedback and suggestions! We will continue to fix and optimize known issues in future updates. If you have more feedback, feel free to join our Discord and share your suggestions in the [b]Feedback[/b] section.[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 11 – Enhanced Game Tutorial, UI & Performance Optimization
notes.notes: [p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after selecting a language but not entering the game, returning to the main menu would require selecting the language again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the selected map was not highlighted when entering it from the map selection screen.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Improved crosshair visibility by enhancing contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hit animations for the crosshair and death sound effects for monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an explosion airdrop range indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to disable controller vibration.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a key prompt for card selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced UI animation strength for mission guidance to improve clarity for missions and mining instructions.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized VRAM and memory usage for better stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an operation guide list in the bottom-left corner: sprint command is now always displayed, and guide size has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted minimap size and marker colors to improve recognition.[/p][/*][/olist][p]We appreciate all feedback and suggestions from our survivors. notes.title: [UPDATE] Adjustable Damage Numbers, Balance Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where setting a non-standard aspect ratio resolution in the settings would cause misalignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if the player did not enter the game on the first attempt and returned to the UI, it would require re-selecting the language.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash issue caused by the auto-language initialization function. This detection has been removed, and language selection is now fully handled by the player.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Further performance optimization: reduced package size from 4.4 GB to 4.0 GB.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to toggle damage number display, along with adjustable number size (Settings → Gameplay).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted monster damage (damage reduced by 15%).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted difficulty of the last three maps (overall difficulty reduced by 15%).[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you to all Survivors for your feedback and suggestions! We will continue fixing and optimizing the known issues in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Got more feedback? Join our Discord channel![/p]
